requirements.statement: Only finance administrators can delete invoices.
requirements.source_quote: Only finance administrators can delete invoices.
ambiguity_notes: Who counts as a finance administrator is not defined.
Conflicts with line 2, which lets any user delete invoices they created.

requirements.statement: Any user can delete invoices they created.
requirements.source_quote: Any user can delete invoices they created.
ambiguity_notes: Conflicts with line 1, which restricts deletion to finance administrators.
Not stated whether this applies to invoices in every state (for example already sent or paid).

requirements.statement: Invoices must be exported as PDF only.
requirements.source_quote: Invoices must be exported as PDF only.
ambiguity_notes: Conflicts with line 4, which requires export to Excel.
Not stated who can export or whether single or bulk export is meant.

requirements.statement: Users must be able to export invoices to Excel.
requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to export invoices to Excel.
ambiguity_notes: Conflicts with line 3, which allows PDF only.
Which users, and which invoice fields to include, are not stated.
Conflicts with line 6, which requires recovery for 30 days.
Not stated whether permanent removal includes backups and audit records.

requirements.statement: Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days.
requirements.source_quote: Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days.
ambiguity_notes: Conflicts with line 5, which requires permanent removal.
Not stated who can recover, or what happens after the 30 days.

clarifying_questions.question: Who may delete an invoice: only finance administrators, or also any user for invoices they created?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Sets the permission model for an irreversible-looking action.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Deletion permissions cannot be specified; users may be wrongly allowed or blocked.

clarifying_questions.question: Is export PDF only, or should Excel export also be supported?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Determines which export formats are in scope.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Export scope cannot be specified; one of the two must requirements will be unmet.

clarifying_questions.question: When an invoice is deleted, is it removed permanently at once, or kept recoverable for 30 days before permanent removal?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Decides data retention and whether deletion can be undone, which may have legal effect for financial records.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Deletion behaviour and data storage cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: If deleted invoices are recoverable for 30 days, who can recover them and what happens when the 30 days end?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines recovery permissions and final removal behaviour.

conflicts.description: Line 1 says only finance administrators can delete invoices; line 2 says any user can delete invoices they created. Both are kept unreconciled.
Line 3 says invoices must be exported as PDF only; line 4 says users must be able to export to Excel. Both are kept unreconciled.
Line 5 says deleted invoices are removed permanently; line 6 says they must be recoverable for 30 days. Both are kept unreconciled.

proposed_status_changes.reason: Contradicts REQ-002 on who may delete invoices.
Contradicts REQ-001 on who may delete invoices.
Contradicts REQ-006 on permanent removal versus 30-day recovery.
